description: This file implements sensor management functions for Zephyr RTOS, including sensor configuration, sensitivity, interval management, and runtime thread handling.

methods.name: sensing_sensor_type_to_chan
methods.description: Converts sensor type to corresponding sensor channel enum.

methods.name: arbitrate_interval
methods.description: Determines the minimum interval requested by all clients for a sensor.

methods.name: set_arbitrate_interval
methods.description: Sets the sensor's sampling interval and updates hardware attributes.

methods.name: config_interval
methods.description: Configures sensor interval based on client requests.

methods.name: arbitrate_sensitivity
methods.description: Determines the minimum sensitivity requested by all clients for a sensor.

methods.name: set_arbitrate_sensitivity
methods.description: Sets sensor sensitivity/hysteresis based on arbitration.

methods.name: config_sensitivity
methods.description: Configures sensor sensitivity for a specific index.

methods.name: config_sensor
methods.description: Configures both interval and sensitivity for a sensor.

methods.name: sensor_later_config
methods.description: Performs deferred sensor configuration for sensors marked for later update.

methods.name: sensing_runtime_thread
methods.description: Main runtime thread handling sensor configuration events.

methods.name: save_config_and_notify
methods.description: Saves sensor configuration and signals runtime thread.

methods.name: set_sensor_state
methods.description: Sets the operational state of a sensor.

methods.name: init_connection
methods.description: Initializes a sensing connection between source and sink sensors.

methods.name: sensing_sensor_polling_timer
methods.description: Timer callback to read sensor data.

methods.name: init_sensor
methods.description: Initializes a sensing sensor, including timer and client list.

methods.name: sensing_init
methods.description: Zephyr device initialization function for sensing subsystem.

methods.name: open_sensor
methods.description: Creates a new sensing connection for a sensor.

methods.name: close_sensor
methods.description: Closes a sensing connection and updates configuration.

methods.name: sensing_register_callback
methods.description: Registers a callback list for a sensing connection.

methods.name: set_interval
methods.description: Sets the data reporting interval for a sensing connection.

methods.name: get_interval
methods.description: Retrieves the current interval for a sensing connection.

methods.name: set_sensitivity
methods.description: Sets the sensitivity/hysteresis for a sensing connection.

methods.name: get_sensitivity
methods.description: Retrieves the sensitivity for a sensing connection.

methods.name: sensing_get_sensors
methods.description: Retrieves the list of available sensors.
